id: title:Gilbert09:map deltalake object store access errors to an actionable message

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion: warehouse_sources backend converts ClickHouse DeltaLake kernel object-store permission errors into actionable user-facing messages.
review.reason: The change adds a specific error mapping and a corresponding test for a DeltaLake permission error, improving warehouse ingestion reliability and user diagnostics. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and test, but the actual production benefit and adoption are not demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit inferred. No WPR, release, or author metadata used.

observations.behavior: Adds a new entry to ExtractErrors mapping a DeltaLake kernel permission error to an actionable message.
observations.code_quote: "The operation lacked the necessary privileges to complete": "Access was denied when reading the provided file",
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion: warehouse_sources backend converts ClickHouse DeltaLake kernel object-store errors into user-facing permission-denied messages.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that the permission error is mapped and raises an actionable message.
